The arrow shows the path of an α-particle travelling towards the centre of a gold nucleus.
gold nucleus
Which description of the path of the α-particle after striking the gold nucleus is correct?
The α-particle is deflected through a very small angle towards the top of the page.
A
The α-particle is deflected back along its initial path.
B
The α-particle carries on in a straight line with no deflection.
C
The α-particle is captured by the nucleus and goes into orbit around it.
D

options.label: A
options.text: The α-particle is deflected through a very small angle towards the top of the page.

options.label: B
options.text: The α-particle is deflected back along its initial path.

options.label: C
options.text: The α-particle carries on in a straight line with no deflection.

options.label: D
options.text: The α-particle is captured by the nucleus and goes into orbit around it.
